title: tinyhumansai/openhuman
description: Your Personal AI super intelligence. Private, Simple and extremely powerful.OpenHuman   OpenHuman is your Personal AI super intelligence. Private, Simple and extremely powerful. Discord • Reddit • X/Twitter • Docs • Follow @senamakel (Creator) 🇺🇸 English | 🇨🇳 简体中文 | 🇯🇵 日本語 | 🇰🇷 한국어 | 🇩🇪 Deutsch Early Beta: Under active development. Expect rough edges. To install or get started, either download from the website over at tinyhumans.ai/openhuman or run # Download DMG, EXEs over at https://tinyhumans.ai/openhuman or run in from your terminal # For macOS or Linux x64 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinyhumansai/openhuman/main/scripts/install.sh | bash # For Windows irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tinyhumansai/openhuman/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex What is OpenHuman? OpenHuman is an open-source agentic assistant designed to integrate with you in your daily life. Each bullet links to the deeper writeup in the docs. Simple, UI-first & Human A clean desktop experience and short onboarding paths take you from install to a working agent in a few clicks — no config-first setup, no terminal required. The agent has a face: a desktop mascot that speaks, reacts to its surroundings, joins your Google Meets as a real participant, remembers you across weeks, and keeps thinking in the background even when you've stopped typing. 118+ third-party integrations with auto-fetch: plug into Gmail, Notion, GitHub, Slack, Stripe, Calendar, Drive, Linear, Jira and the rest of your stack with one-click OAuth. Every connection is exposed to the agent as a typed tool, and every twenty minutes the core walks each active connection and pulls fresh data into the memory tree. No prompts, no polling loops you have to write, so the agent already has tomorrow's context this morning. Managed integrations are backend-proxied through OpenHuman's Composio connector layer. If you want to run Composio directly instead of using the managed backend path, configure direct mode with your own Composio API key; real-time trigger webhooks then need to be hosted and wired by you. Memory Tree + Obsidian Wiki: a local-first knowledge base built from your data and your activity. Everything you connect is canonicalized into ≤3k-token Markdown chunks, scored, and folded into hierarchical summary trees stored in SQLite on your machine. The same chunks land as .md files in an Obsidian-compatible vault you can open, browse and edit, inspired by Karpathy's obsidian-wiki workflow. Batteries included: web search, a web-fetch scraper, a full coder toolset (filesystem, git, lint, test, grep), and native voice (STT in, ElevenLabs TTS out, mascot lip-sync, live Google Meet agent) are wired in by default. Model routing sends each task to the right LLM (reasoning, fast, or vision) under one subscription. No "install a plugin to read files" friction. Optional local AI via Ollama for on-device workloads. Smart token compression (TokenJuice): every tool call, scrape result, email body, and search payload is run through a token compression layer before it touches any LLM Model. HTML is converted to Markdown, long URLs are shortened, and verbose tool output is deduped and summarized via a configurable rule overlay etc... CJK, emoji, and other multi-byte text are preserved grapheme-by-grapheme — never stripped. You get the same information but at a fraction of the tokens. Reducing cost & latency by up to 80%. Messaging channels and privacy & security: inbound/outbound across the channels you already use, with workflow data that stays on device, encrypted locally, treated as yours. Contributing from source New contributor? Start with CONTRIBUTING.md for the fork/PR workflow and local validation commands, or use the copy-paste AI-agent prompt in CONTRIBUTING-BEGINNERS.md. The short path is: Install Git, Node.js 24+, pnpm 10.10.0, Rust 1.93.0 (rustfmt + clippy), CMake, Ninja, ripgrep, and the platform desktop build prerequisites. Fork and clone the repo, then run git submodule update --init --recursive before pnpm install so the vendored Tauri/CEF sources are present. Use pnpm dev for web-only UI work, pnpm --filter openhuman-app dev:app for the desktop shell, and focused checks such as pnpm typecheck, pnpm format:check, and cargo check -p openhuman --lib before opening a PR. Deeper docs: Architecture · Getting Set Up · Cloud Deploy. Context in minutes, not weeks OpenHuman is the first agent harness that gets to know you in minutes. Inspired by Karpathy's LLM Knowledgebase. Most agents start cold. Hermes learns by watching you work; OpenClaw waits for plugins to ferry context in. Either way, you spend days or weeks before the agent knows enough about your stack to be genuinely useful. OpenHuman summarizes and compresses all your documents, emails & chats; and creates a memory graph that lets your agent remember everything about you. OpenHuman skips the wait. Connect your accounts, let auto-fetch pull data locally on a 20-minute loop, and then have Memory Trees compress everything into Markdown files stored intelligently in a Karpathy-style Obsidian wiki. In just one sync pass, the agent has full (compressed) context of your inbox, your calendar, your repos, your docs, your messages. No training period. No "give it a few weeks.". It becomes you, controlled by you. Already self-host agentmemory across other coding agents? OpenHuman ships an optional Memory backend that proxies to it — set memory.backend = "agentmemory" in config.toml and the same durable store powers OpenHuman alongside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode. See the agentmemory backend page for setup. OpenHuman vs Other Agent Harnesses High-level comparison (products evolve, so verify against each vendor). OpenHuman is built to minimize vendor sprawl, keep workflow knowledge on-device, and give the agent a persistent memory of your data, not only chat. impact_score.reason: OpenHuman 以开源方式整合了记忆树、智能 token 压缩、118+ 第三方服务连接等工程能力，定位个人 AI 助手赛道，架构设计有亮点（本地 SQLite 记忆树 + Obsidian Wiki 双轨存储、TokenJuice 压缩层可降本 80%）。但团队规模小、产品处于早期测试阶段（明确标注 rough edges），短期内难以改变竞争格局。评分 5 分，属于值得关注的产品发布，但远未达到行业范式转移级别。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 记忆树+TokenJuice 压缩架构的实际效果与'超级智能'声称之间的落差，以及早期测试版的稳定性和隐私实现是否名副其实

hype_assessment.reason: README 中大量使用'super intelligence'、'extremely powerful'、'becomes you'等 PR 话术，'超级智能'的定性明显夸大了一个早期测试版桌面应用的实际能力。但项目确实提供了可运行产品、详细技术文档和具体架构说明（Memory Tree、TokenJuice、118+集成均为可验证的功能点），并非纯概念炒作，属于'有干货但有水分'的典型技术创业项目宣传。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 核心创新在于工程整合而非基础研究突破：将多源异构数据（邮件、日历、文档、代码仓库）通过 OAuth 自动拉取→HTML→Markdown 转换→去重摘要→≤3k token 分块→SQLite 记忆树存储→Obsidian 可浏览 .md 导出的完整数据管道工程化。TokenJuice 压缩层对 CJK/emoji 多字节文本的逐字保留处理是务实的细节优化。整体是对 Andrej Karpathy 知识库工作流理念的产品化实现。
domain_disruption.business_model: GNU 开源许可证发布，短期内不构成直接商业威胁，但'本地优先+开放集成+免训练即用'的定位对 Copilot、Gemini、ChatGPT 等封闭生态形成差异化竞争叙事。若未来推出托管服务或企业版，可能切入个人知识管理与企业助手之间的蓝海市场。

compound_value.reason: OpenHuman 在个人 AI 助手赛道提出了一个有吸引力的愿景：通过本地记忆树和自动数据同步，让 AI 在使用中持续加深对用户的理解，形成个体级数据复利效应（使用越久→记忆越深→切换成本越高→粘性越强）。然而，从 VC 视角看，长期复利面临三重结构性制约：（1）GNU 开源许可证意味着核心技术可被随意 fork，无法形成代码层面的护城河，商业化路径模糊——虽提及「one subscription」模型路由付费，但开源竞品可零成本复现相同体验；（2）项目处于早期 beta、由单人（senamakel）主导，执行风险极高，从 beta 到可规模化商业产品之间有巨大鸿沟；（3）个人 AI 助手赛道正被 Apple Intelligence、Google Gemini、Microsoft Copilot、OpenAI ChatGPT 等巨头以百倍资源碾压，OpenHuman 的核心创意（记忆树架构、TokenJuice 压缩、Obsidian 集成）更可能被大厂吸收内化为自身功能，而非独立成长为行业基石。3-5 年后该具体项目大概率不会成为赛道基础设施，但其「本地优先+持久记忆」的产品理念可能影响行业方向。

Supported backends Backend Target devices Metal Apple Silicon BLAS All BLIS All SYCL Intel GPU OpenVINO [In Progress] Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs MUSA Moore Threads GPU CUDA Nvidia GPU HIP AMD GPU ZenDNN AMD CPU Vulkan GPU CANN Ascend NPU OpenCL Adreno GPU IBM zDNN IBM Z & LinuxONE WebGPU [In Progress] All RPC All Hexagon [In Progress] Snapdragon VirtGPU VirtGPU APIR Obtaining and quantizing models The Hugging Face platform hosts a number of LLMs compatible with llama.cpp: Trending LLaMA You can either manually download the GGUF file or directly use any llama.cpp-compatible models from Hugging Face or other model hosting sites, by using this CLI argument: -hf <user>/<model>[:quant]. For example: llama-cli -hf ggml-org/gemma-3-1b-it-GGUF By default, the CLI would download from Hugging Face, you can switch to other options with the environment variable MODEL_ENDPOINT. The MODEL_ENDPOINT must point to a Hugging Face compatible API endpoint. After downloading a model, use the CLI tools to run it locally - see below. llama.cpp requires the model to be stored in the GGUF file format. Models in other data formats can be converted to GGUF using the convert_*.py Python scripts in this repo. The Hugging Face platform provides a variety of online tools for converting, quantizing and hosting models with llama.cpp: Use the GGUF-my-repo space to convert to GGUF format and quantize model weights to smaller sizes Use the GGUF-my-LoRA space to convert LoRA adapters to GGUF format (more info: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/discussions/10123) Use the GGUF-editor space to edit GGUF meta data in the browser (more info: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/discussions/9268) Use the Inference Endpoints to directly host llama.cpp in the cloud (more info: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/discussions/9669) To learn more about model quantization, read this documentation llama-cli A CLI tool for accessing and experimenting with most of llama.cpp's functionality. tldr: llama.cpp 是一个纯C/C++的LLM推理引擎，支持多硬件平台和多种量化格式，新增gpt-oss MXFP4原生格式支持及HuggingFace缓存集成
objective_summary: ggml-org 维护的 llama.cpp 项目近期完成多项更新：HuggingFace 缓存目录标准化、与 NVIDIA 合作支持 gpt-oss 模型的 MXFP4 原生格式、llama-server 新增多模态能力、发布 VS Code 和 Vim/Neovim 的 FIM 补全插件。
key_logic_flow: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写、零外部依赖的 LLM 推理框架，核心依赖 ggml 张量库
近期关键更新包括：通过 -hf 下载的模型现存储于标准 HuggingFace 缓存目录，实现与其他 HF 工具共享
与 NVIDIA 合作新增对 gpt-oss 模型的 MXFP4 原生格式支持，属于行业首次将微观浮点格式用于 LLM 推理
llama-server 新增多模态支持（PR #12898），并发布了 VS Code 和 Vim/Neovim 的 FIM 代码补全插件
支持 Apple Silicon（Metal/ARM NEON）、NVIDIA GPU（CUDA）、AMD GPU（HIP）、Intel GPU（SYCL）、Vulkan、RISC-V 等多种硬件后端
提供 1.5-bit 到 8-bit 的整数量化和 CPU+GPU 混合推理，适配超出 VRAM 容量的大模型运行场景
Hugging Face 推理端点已原生支持 GGUF 格式，并提供 GGUF 在线转换、量化和编辑器等配套工具

impact_score.reason: llama.cpp 已是 LLM 本地推理的事实标准之一，本次更新属于「重要版本迭代」而非范式转移。核心加分项包括：与 NVIDIA 合作首次将 MXFP4 微观浮点格式引入 LLM 推理（可能改变量化精度与效率的平衡点）、HuggingFace 缓存目录标准化打通了 HF 生态的数据共享链路、llama-server 多模态支持拓展了其从纯文本推理到端到端服务的边界。但缺乏颠覆性架构突破或全新能力涌现，综合评定 6.5 分——改变局部竞争格局，尚未引发行业范式转移。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: MXFP4 原生格式支持对推理精度与显存占用的实际提升幅度，以及 HF 缓存标准化能否终结 GGUF 模型文件的碎片化管理

hype_assessment.reason: llama.cpp 项目一贯以工程实干著称，README 中未见「颠覆」「革命性」等 PR 套话。MXFP4 支持明确标注为与 NVIDIA 的协作成果并直接引用 PR 链接，HF 缓存迁移提供了具体的行为变更说明，FIM 插件给出了可访问的仓库地址——每一项更新均可追溯、可验证，属于典型的「做多说少」开源工程风格。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 行业首次将 MXFP4（4-bit 微观浮点）格式原生集成到 LLM 推理引擎中，区别于传统的整数量化（INT4），浮点量化有望在保持极低位宽的同时更好地保留模型输出的分布特性，尤其在 gpt-oss 等新型模型架构上可能解锁精度-效率的新 Pareto 前沿。此外，CPU+GPU 混合推理和 1.5-bit 超低比特量化构成了面向消费级硬件的完整推理方案。
domain_disruption.business_model: 通过 HF 缓存标准化和 GGUF 格式在 HuggingFace Inference Endpoints 的原生支持，llama.cpp 正在从「极客工具」进化为 HuggingFace 生态的标准化推理后端。这降低了中小团队和独立开发者的本地部署门槛，可能侵蚀部分云端推理 API 的市场份额，同时为边缘计算和隐私敏感场景提供了无需联网的可行替代方案。

compound_value.reason: llama.cpp 已成为本地 LLM 推理的事实标准，其复利效应体现在三个飞轮上：(1) 模型架构支持越多 → 用户基数越大 → 社区贡献越活跃 → 新模型支持越快；(2) 硬件后端越多 → 部署场景越广 → 硬件厂商主动合作（如 NVIDIA MXFP4 共建）→ 生态锁定越深；(3) 下游工具链越丰富（Ollama、LMStudio、GPT4All 等均依赖它）→ 迁移成本越高 → 替代难度越大。该项目的纯 C/C++ 零依赖架构使其极难被性能竞品取代，而近期与 NVIDIA 在 MXFP4 原生格式上的合作表明，硬件厂商选择'融入'而非'替代'，进一步巩固其基础设施地位。3-5 年内，只要本地推理需求存在，llama.cpp 几乎确定仍是该赛道的基石项目。扣分因素在于开源商业化路径不清晰，价值捕获能力受限，但作为基础设施的护城河足够深。

competitive_casualty: 闭源推理优化初创公司
ONNX Runtime（边缘推理场景）
云端独占型推理 API 服务商（本地部署场景被蚕食）
Intel OpenVINO（开发者心智份额流失）
market_opportunities: 基于 llama.cpp 的 MXFP4 原生格式支持（与 NVIDIA 合作），可开发面向企业级 GPU 推理优化的定制化部署方案，降低大模型推理的显存占用与成本，抢占私有化推理中台市场
利用 llama.cpp 新发布的 VS Code 和 Vim/Neovim FIM 补全插件生态，创业者可基于 GGUF 模型构建垂直领域的本地化代码助手 SaaS 服务（如金融合规代码审查、医疗信息化代码生成），主打数据不出本地的安全卖点
HuggingFace 推理端点原生支持 GGUF 格式标志着该格式成为边缘推理的事实标准，建议 AI 基础设施团队将 GGUF 模型转换与量化工具链纳入 CI/CD 流程，建立内部模型格式的 GGUF 优先策略

risk_matrix.regulatory: GGUF 格式与纯 C/C++ 推理引擎大幅降低了 LLM 部署门槛，可能被用于绕过云端 AI 服务的内容安全审查机制，存在下游监管追溯困难的问题；此外欧盟 AI Act 对开源模型豁免条款的适用边界尚不明确，本地化推理的合规责任归属存在灰色地带
risk_matrix.technological: MXFP4 微观浮点格式作为行业首次应用于 LLM 推理的新兴技术，长期生态支持存在不确定性——若 NVIDIA 后续调整 GPU 架构中对 MXFP4 的硬件加速策略，相关推理优化管线可能面临重构；此外 Apple MLX、Google AI Edge 等平台原生推理方案可能削弱 GGUF 跨平台优势
risk_matrix.competitive: Ollama（基于 llama.cpp 的上层封装）正在快速吞噬终端用户心智，其品牌认知度已远超底层 llama.cpp，存在核心技术被下游产品"平台化替代"的风险；vLLM 在服务端高吞吐场景持续优化，可能挤压 llama.cpp 在服务器推理市场的空间
risk_matrix.ethical: 极低推理门槛（1.5-bit 量化 + CPU 运行）大幅扩大了 LLM 的可及性，但也意味着深度伪造文本生成、自动化社交工程攻击、批量虚假评论生成等滥用场景的防御成本同步上升；本地离线推理使得传统 API 级别的安全审计与用量监控手段完全失效
additional: 供应链依赖风险：llama.cpp 核心维护团队规模较小（ggml-org），项目高度依赖少数贡献者，若核心维护者流失或 NVIDIA 合作终止，项目迭代可能大幅放缓
碎片化风险：众多语言绑定和 UI 衍生项目质量参差不齐，下游用户可能因使用未经审计的三方封装而产生安全漏洞或模型投毒风险

key_logic_flow: agentmemory 是一个 npm 全局安装的命令行工具，启动后在 localhost:3111 运行记忆服务器，并在 localhost:3113 提供实时查看器。
它通过 12 个生命周期钩子（SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、PreToolUse、PostToolUse、PreCompact、Stop 等）自动捕获编码智能体的行为，无需手动记录。
捕获的会话数据经 4 层记忆整合流程（consolidation）与衰减机制（decay + auto-forget）压缩为可检索的结构化记忆。
检索采用 BM25 关键词匹配 + 向量语义搜索 + 知识图谱的三路混合检索，通过 RRF（倒数排名融合）合并结果，自报 R@5 达 95.2%。
嵌入模型使用本地运行的 all-MiniLM-L6-v2，无需外部 API 密钥；存储层基于 SQLite 和 iii-engine，无外部依赖，每会话约消耗 1900 tokens。

Plain files and self-owned software can last through the ages. Try it out: app.files.md (Beta). Main site: files.md. I have been building this project for 5 years. Consider supporting on GitHub 💚. Dump your thoughts · How to think deeply · Second Brain? · Journal, tasks and checklists Another note taking app? Maybe. Open the chat and send a message: Choose where to save (can do later): With this flow you can quickly save notes, tasks, journal records and checklists. Save things in the chatbot Open the chat, write something and press Enter: That's it. Telegram Bot. Other messengers will follow. How to think deeply Connect ideas. Let them compound. Think through. I used app.files.md to grow my knowledge about brain and software development I added new notes to either brain or dev folders. One idea per note I made connections between the relevant notes in the web app (type [) Everything is connected, just as in our brain I spent time travelling through the notes and thinking it through At one point, some brain and dev notes appeared very related This connection between two different domains produced an insight I wrote an article based on that insight: Cognitive Load in Software Development All this activity helped me to: Think deeply (which is very important in the AI-age) Think systematically and see the bigger picture Write insightful texts To achieve all that, you'll have to use your brain, not advanced templates or AI workflows. Start with no structure at all, 0 folders One idea per note Every note should be understood without context Apply new knowledge immediately, don't save it for future self Link related notes Revisit your notes and think through My friends and I have been using this simple setup for five years, and it works well. Second Brain? I'll quote I Deleted My Second Brain: Obsidian is a brilliant piece of software. I love it, dearly. But like anything, without restraint, it can also be a trap. Markdown files in nested folders. Plugins that track your productivity. Graph views that suggest omniscience. There’s an illusion of mastery in watching your notes web into constellations. But constellations are projections. They tell stories. They do not guarantee understanding. When I first started using PKM tools, I believed I was solving a problem of forgetting. Later, I believed I was solving a problem of integration. Eventually, I realized I had created a new problem: deferral. The more my system grew, the more I deferred the work of thought to some future self who would sort, tag, distill, and extract the gold. That self never arrived. The Second Brain is thrilling. Advanced guru templates, plugins and AI workflows... One wants to scrape the wisdom of the whole internet. There's some beauty in this neat system. Every new note brings dopamine. Second Brain gets better and better. However, the first brain never actually gets smarter. And that's an issue - in the AI age, your first brain is as valuable as ever. Use your brain to think through the notes. The tool is not important, your thinking is. Before adding a new note, try to answer these questions: How this new knowledge can sharpen my judgment or expand my taxonomy? How can I see the world differently, given this new knowledge? Notes can prevent experience Reading and taking notes can easily fool us into believing that we understand a text We think we understand, but in reality we just know At some point our "knowing" is so good, that we start feeling that we actually do it (or at least tried) The worst thing is that we don’t let new experiences emerge because we already have knowledge. It's a knowledge barrier. Life gives us opportunities to live through new experiences, but we refuse, because "we already know". Self-help through reading and taking notes? 🧘‍ Harm caused at the emotional level must be healed at the emotional level. Not through intellectual work and taking notes. Reading without action is entertainment. A form of procrastination. No amount of self-help books can heal emotional wounds. What can help is psychotherapy, rescripting and chair work. Meditation. Healing happens by feeling. When to take notes If your goal is to: Develop a deeper, more structured understanding of something Do research Write an article or a book Then taking notes is perfectly fine. Journal Are you feeling good about something? Send a message. Then click "To Journal". Or just add jj or жж at the end of your message. Your record is gonna be saved nicely in the journal/YYYY.MM Month.md file. Tasks ✅ You're in the flow. A colleague asks you to send a report. Holding that in your head drains energy. Drop a message and stay in flow. Add only small, actionable items. Not things like "Plan a vacation". Add the first tiny step of what should be done anyway. Not what you wish to be done, but don't have motivation just yet. Your task list should not create a feeling of guilt. For tasks that should be done later press "To Later". The only issue is, it is not as wildly popular in EU/USA. I've come to the idea that we can transform app.files.md to a chat once we decrease the window size! Would be default behaviour on mobiles. 04.06.2025 Introduced append-only log for syncing. Stateless sync is tricky to implement - we would have to send all files in every request. Since we're only renaming on server - we'll only track renames. 04.06.2025 For content-only sync (no renames/deletes) we don't store any state on server, we compare hashes & last ctimes 11.11.2024 Removed Wikilinks support. Only plain Markdown links, our knowledge base must be interoperable. 26.10.2024 Updates are now processed sequentially on per-user basis. Because there were some race conditions on concurrent file writings. Also we faced out-of-order forwarded messages processing, and it was impossible to collapse them to one message. 06.10.2024 Removed fyne.io. At first, I wanted a lightweight alternative to Electron, and fyne.io seemed to be an ideal candidate. After a few days working with it 80% of bot functionality was implemented, and I was pretty happy with it. The thing is, to implement the rest of the functionality, we would have to apply A TREMENDOUS amount of effort. I am talking tiny details such as scrolling, emojis rendering, text selecting behaviour, links support, etc. And in future we would have to implement image uploading and markdown/html renderer, which would be also painful in such non-webview based toolkit. As much as I hate using the web stack for the desktop applications, it doesn't seem like we have a choice. Let's try wails.io. 09.09.2024 We use vendoring for dependencies. We want all our few dependencies to be in the repo, so we don't care about blocked/removed dependencies. Our repository is the self-sufficient source of truth. 09.06.2025 We use granular locks (in db, journal, userconfig) instead of one global per user lock so to avoid bottlenecks. Workers might use 3rd party API like ChatGPT, and we don't want to hold user's lock all that time. PATCHED, we added sequential per-user updates processing, bot can't cause RCs on its own, but bot & worker can, so we should continue using granular locks. 20.08.2024 We read every userconfig value from the config file on every access. We don't need load/save whole config before/after bot.Answer() method. We have to reread it every time we need to change it, so we don't write back any stale data. Let's imagine we load config only once before bot.Answer(), next, we may have significant networking delays in bot.Answer() (let's say 2 seconds when making external requests), there are good changes that during those 2 seconds worker.MoveDueTasks() will modify userconfig.Schedule, causing data race (after bot's answer we write back stale data). And we don't want our schedule lost. 08.08.2024 Sanitize Early, we gave up sanitizing in Path method. That's an unexpected behaviour - it breaks paths. We should sanitize everything as soon as we received. Most commands work with md5 hashes, for such cases no sanitize is needed 13.07.2024 gofumpt for stricter formatting. gofumpt is happy with a subset of the formats that gofmt is happy with. The less we have to choose between different formating options, the better 13.07.2024 FS's structure should have userFS name, to reflect the fact it user user-namespaced 09.07.2024 Note term is way too vague. Let's try to use "file" term, without any high level abstraction (like note) 13.08.2024 Gave up on AST parsing/rendering. We had lots of corner cases via AST and the code was way complex. Markdown isn't that hard to parse, we can do it via good old straigforward code. We have 3x times less code now, and it is far less mentally taxing to understand. We did the same for MD->HTML conversion. Telegram doesn't support whole range of HTML tags, so it was easier to write our own md-to-html converter. 08.07.2024 Adherence to Tolerant Reader principles. If enconunter gibberish during parsing - we skip it, but if we encounter flags of valid data (let's say ###) but data itself is invalid - we panic. TODO preserve gibberish during read-write cycle. 07.07.2024 Usage of https://github.com/rivo/uniseg. In Go, strings are read-only slices of bytes. They can be turned into Unicode code points using the for loop or by casting: []rune(str). However, multiple code points may be combined into one user-perceived character or what the Unicode specification calls "grapheme cluster". For example, white circle "⚪" has two runes, but one grapheme cluster. 07.09.2024 Markdown to HTML conversion. User can have invalid Markdown in his notes, and TG API would fail to send invalid Markdown directly. So, first we escape HTML, then we convert user's Markdown to HTML and finally send it via Telegram API as HTML. 13.06.2023 File hashing. Everywhere where we have user input - we should use fs.hash, otherwise we get long filenames, and tg returns INVALID_DATA error (callbackData max 64 bytes) 13.06.2023 Introduced db.go. We had to abstract away Redis anyway (otherwise it's hard to write tests) 13.03.2023 Package db.go doesn't store userID (we often use it separately...) Do we? Maybe we gonna use it without userID (like global bot stats?). Added: moved userID to class. Maybe in later we'll need this class outside of user's scope, but let's stay in the future 😃 13.06.2023 We can't ucfist filename in fs.Put - what if that was user-created file (outside the bot), i.e. it comes with lowercase
tldr: files.md 是一个基于纯 .md 文件的本地优先、隐私优先的开源知识管理工具，已开发五年，强调用大脑思考而非依赖复杂系统。
objective_summary: 开发者 zakirullin 用五年时间构建了 files.md——一个通过浏览器运行的 PWA 应用，以纯 .md 文件存储笔记、日记、任务和清单，数据完全留在用户设备上，不发送到服务器。该项目开源免费，支持离线使用、Telegram 机器人访问、以及可选的云盘或自托管同步。
key_logic_flow: files.md 是一个纯前端 PWA 应用，通过浏览器打开本地 .md 文件夹即可使用，无需安装任何软件
所有数据以纯 .md 文件形式存储在用户设备本地，不向任何服务器发送数据，实现完全隐私
项目代码极度精简，设计目标是一个人或者一个 LLM 就能完整理解整个代码库，便于用户自行扩展
工具支持聊天式快速记录、笔记互链、日记、任务清单、检查清单等核心功能，通过 Telegram 机器人实现移动端访问
同步方案可选：纯本地（无同步）、云盘文件夹同步（iCloud/Dropbox/Google Drive）、自托管 Go 二进制服务器、或官方托管服务
作者的核心设计哲学是反对过度依赖模板和 AI 工作流构建'第二大脑'，强调用户必须用自己的大脑主动回顾笔记、建立连接、深度思考，工具本身越简单越好

impact_score.reason: files.md 是一个打磨了五年的本地优先知识管理 PWA，设计哲学上有一定反差（在 AI 时代强调用大脑而非依赖 AI 工作流），但其技术方案（PWA + 本地 .md 文件 + 可选同步）属于成熟路径，不构成任何范式转移。这是一个制作精良的个人工具，在 Hacker News 或开发者社区会引发一轮关于 PKM 工具的讨论，但不会改变 AI 行业竞争格局。属于小圈子精品发布，影响力限于效率工具爱好者群体。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 代码极简主义主张（一人或一个 LLM 即可理解全部代码）是否真的降低了扩展门槛，以及'用第一大脑思考'的反 AI 工作流哲学在实操中是否可行

hype_assessment.reason: 文章大量使用哲学化叙事（'限制激发创造力'、'星座是投射而非理解'）包装一个本质上常规的 PWA 笔记工具。'第二大脑批判'这一叙事框架具有传播力，但将自身定位为对抗 AI 时代思维惰性的解药，存在一定程度的价值观营销成分。好在产品本身确实存在且开源，五年打磨也属实，水分主要在于叙事升维而非虚构功能。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 无本质性技术突破。PWA 操作本地文件系统（File System Access API）、CodeMirror 编辑器、Go 单二进制同步服务器、Telegram Bot 桥接，均为成熟技术的组合。唯一的工程亮点是刻意控制代码库复杂度至'一人可全量理解'的规模，这是一种设计约束而非技术创新。
domain_disruption.business_model: 开源免费 + 可选官方托管服务（app.files.md Beta）的经典开源商业化路径。对 SaaS 生态无重塑力——它本质上是对 Notion/Obsidian 等重客户端的一个极简替代品，市场规模有限，商业模式高度依赖开发者捐赠和托管付费。

compound_value.reason: 从 VC 视角看，files.md 在商业维度上几乎不具备长期复利效应：(1) 本地优先 + 纯 .md 文件的设计意味着零数据锁定、零切换成本，用户随时可以离开而不损失任何东西——这是护城河的反面；(2) 代码极度精简，'一个人或一个 LLM 就能完整理解整个代码库'，这意味着复制门槛极低，任何人都可以 fork 并推出竞品；(3) 无网络效应——每个用户的笔记是独立的本地文件，用户之间没有互动、没有协作网络、没有双边市场；(4) 变现路径极其有限，仅靠可选托管服务可能支撑一个 lifestyle business，但难以达到 VC 级别的回报倍数；(5) 项目已开发五年仍为单人项目，缺乏团队扩张和商业化加速的信号。该项目在哲学层面（深度思考、反 AI 工作流）有洞见，产品设计克制优雅，但从资本逻辑看，它被刻意设计成'不依赖任何特定工具'——这意味着它自己也不会成为用户依赖的工具。

key_beneficiaries: 本地优先/隐私优先开源社区
competitive_casualty: Obsidian (同为 Markdown 本地化 PKM，但日益复杂化)
Notion、Roam Research (云端锁定型知识管理工具)
AI 驱动的'第二大脑'类创业公司
PKM 付费模板/课程创作者
market_opportunities: 基于'LLM可完整理解整个代码库'的极简架构理念，可面向注重数据主权的企业客户开发本地优先的知识管理工具，结合私有化部署的 LLM 实现智能检索、自动关联与洞察挖掘，形成差异化竞争优势
Telegram 机器人作为轻量级移动端接入层的模式值得桌面优先工具类产品借鉴——以极低开发成本实现移动端快速记录能力，降低用户跨设备使用的摩擦，尤其适合个人开发者和小型团队
纯 .md 文件 + PWA + 可选自托管同步的架构范式为 AI 时代个人数据主权工具提供了清晰范本，创业者可关注'本地 LLM 推理 × 个人知识库'的交叉地带，打造真正私密且智能的第二大脑替代方案

risk_matrix.regulatory: 无——项目完全本地运行，不收集用户数据，不上传任何信息到服务器，不涉及 GDPR、AI Act 或数据跨境传输等监管框架的约束
risk_matrix.technological: PWA 方案依赖浏览器生态的持续演进，在处理包含数千个 .md 文件的大型知识库时存在性能天花板；CodeMirror 编辑器在移动端体验有限；Go 同步服务作为单体二进制，若缺乏社区贡献可能面临安全漏洞修复滞后的风险
risk_matrix.competitive: Obsidian、Logseq、Notion 等成熟工具已深度占据个人知识管理市场，各自拥有庞大的插件生态和社区网络效应；files.md 虽以极简哲学实现差异化定位，但功能深度差距可能导致用户迁移后的长期留存率不足，难以形成足够大的用户基数来维持项目可持续性
risk_matrix.ethical: 无——该工具以隐私优先为核心理念，不涉及数据收集、算法偏见、深度伪造或就业冲击等伦理问题；作者倡导'用自己的大脑思考'的哲学属于健康的技术使用观
additional: 单人项目存在严重的巴士因子风险：作者已投入五年但无明确社区治理结构和继任计划，若维护者因任何原因退出，项目可能陷入停滞
纯 .md 文件格式天然缺乏结构化数据支持，在用户需求从笔记管理转向知识图谱、数据库查询等高级场景时存在根本性扩展瓶颈，可能限制工具从轻量级应用向严肃生产力工具的演进路径
官方托管服务（app.files.md）作为 Beta 版本，若未来转为商业运营，可能与其开源免费的核心承诺产生张力，影响社区信任
